description: Scaffold the no-build ES-module project and engine core, plus the offline verification harness. This establishes the runtime shape (importmap CDN loading), the render/loop/input engine layer, the central config module, and the sandbox verification tooling that all later features depend on. Independent of game-specific logic.
steps: Create index.html at workspace root with: (a) a <script type="importmap"> mapping bare specifiers to jsDelivr ESM builds: "three" -> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js, "three/addons/" -> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/, and "cannon-es" -> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cannon-es@0.20.0/dist/cannon-es.js ; (b) a full-window <canvas id="game"> or <div id="app"> mount; (c) placeholder HUD DOM containers (#hud with speedometer, lap timer, lap counter, best-lap elements) and a #countdown overlay and a #loading overlay; (d) <script type="module" src="./src/main.js">. Link styles.css.

Create styles.css: full-viewport canvas (margin 0, overflow hidden), HUD styling (fixed corners, monospace speedometer, semi-transparent panels), centered countdown overlay with large text, loading overlay shown until first frame.

Create src/config.js exporting a single frozen CONFIG object with sections: render (shadows, fov, pixelRatio cap), camera (chase distance/height/stiffness/damping), physics (gravity, timestep, subSteps), vehicle (mass, engineForce, brakeForce, maxSteer, steerSpeed, suspension stiffness/damping/compression/rest/maxTravel, wheel radius/friction), handling (driftFrictionMultiplier, handbrakeFrictionRear), and world (groundSize). Values chosen for arcade-leaning feel. This is the single source of tunables.

Create src/engine/loop.js: a fixed-timestep game loop class (accumulator pattern) that exposes onUpdate(dt) for physics/logic at a fixed step and onRender(alpha) for interpolated rendering via requestAnimationFrame; start()/stop(); tracks elapsed time. Keep it framework-agnostic (no Three imports) so it is unit-testable.

Create src/engine/input.js: keyboard input manager. Tracks WASD + Arrow keys (throttle/brake/left/right), Space (handbrake), R (reset), and P/Esc (pause optional). Exposes a getState() returning {throttle, brake, steer:-1..1, handbrake, reset} with edge-detection helper for reset. Attaches/detaches window listeners; prevents default on arrow/space scrolling.

Create src/engine/renderer.js: wraps THREE.WebGLRenderer + THREE.Scene + THREE.PerspectiveCamera; sets pixelRatio cap, shadowMap enabled (PCFSoft), handles window resize; exposes scene, camera, renderer, render() and a helper to add resize handling. Uses `import * as THREE from 'three'`.

Create src/engine/camera.js: ChaseCamera class that given a target position + heading each frame smoothly follows behind and above using critically-damped lerp/slerp (uses CONFIG.camera). Pure-ish math kept in a helper (src/game/logic/cameraMath.js exporting dampVec3-like function) so it can be unit tested without Three.

Create src/main.js as a minimal bootstrap for now: import config, create renderer, add a temporary ground plane + directional light + ambient light + a placeholder box, start the loop rotating the box, hide loading overlay on first frame. Wire ChaseCamera to the placeholder box so the engine layer is demonstrably working. (Later features replace the placeholder with the real car/track.)

Create scripts/check.mjs: recursively find every .js/.mjs under src/ and scripts/ and run `node --check` on each via child_process; also parse index.html to assert the importmap contains three and cannon-es entries and that #game/#app and #hud exist. Exit non-zero on any failure with a clear report. Must NOT rely on NODE_OPTIONS.

Create scripts/serve.mjs: a zero-dependency Node http static file server (correct MIME types incl. application/javascript for .js/.mjs, text/html, text/css) serving the workspace root on a PORT (default 8080), used for local verification and as the `npm start` target.

Create package.json (zero runtime dependencies): name, type:module, scripts { start: 'node scripts/serve.mjs', check: 'node scripts/check.mjs', test: 'node --test test/' }. Make clear in a comment/field that no install is required to run.

Create src/game/logic/cameraMath.js with pure exported functions (e.g. expDamp(current, target, lambda, dt) and dampAngle) and src/game/logic/format.js with formatLapTime(ms)->'M:SS.mmm'. Add test/logic.test.js using node --test asserting expDamp converges toward target and formatLapTime formats known values (e.g. 61234 -> '1:01.234', 0 -> '0:00.000').
acceptance_criteria: `node scripts/check.mjs` exits 0 and reports every src/ and scripts/ file syntax-valid and confirms importmap + mount + hud present in index.html
`node --test test/` passes all cameraMath and format tests
Starting `node scripts/serve.mjs` and requesting GET / returns HTTP 200 with index.html containing the importmap referencing three and cannon-es
index.html loads src/main.js as a module and references styles.css; no bundler or npm install is required to open the page in a browser with internet
verification: Run `node scripts/serve.mjs &` then `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8080/` returns 200, and `curl -s http://localhost:8080/ | grep -c cannon-es` >= 1; then kill the server
findings: Scaffold complete and verified offline. check.mjs syntax-checks 10 modules and validates index.html (importmap three+cannon-es, #game/#app mount, #hud, module main.js, styles.css) -> exits 0. 15 unit tests (cameraMath, format, loop) pass. Static server returns HTTP 200 on /, served HTML contains cannon-es, and .js/.mjs are served as application/javascript. IMPORTANT DEVIATION (Node v22 quirk): `node --test test/` treats `test/` as a module entry and fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND; the working directory form is a glob. The package.json `test` script was therefore set to `node --test "test/**/*.test.js"` (run via `npm test`). Later features should use the glob form, not a bare `test/` dir. NODE_OPTIONS must be cleared (env -u NODE_OPTIONS) for all node/npm invocations because a missing proxy-bootstrap preload is configured. Backgrounding a server in a single bash call needs the PID captured on its own line plus an explicit timeout; piping server startup to head or using pkill caused SIGTERM (143) in the harness. Added test/loop.test.js (beyond the required cameraMath/format tests) and .gitignore. Fixed-timestep step counts are float-sensitive (0.05/0.01 yields 4 not 5 steps) so loop test asserts a tolerant range.
